purpose: Develop a deployment-compatible detector from genuinely generated controlled-laboratory traffic.

relationship_to_ciciot2023.ciciot2023_role: Offline model-development and benchmark dataset used by Exp001-Exp009.
relationship_to_ciciot2023.deployment_dataset_role: Separate controlled-laboratory dataset generated for deployment-compatible model development.

feature_generation_rule: All features must be derived from observed packets in the corresponding fixed packet window without consulting class labels.
selection_rule: The final window policy and model will be selected from measured validation evidence, not predetermined performance targets.
current_state: No Dataset-B training acquisition, trained deployment model, predictions, or deployment metrics existed when v2 was frozen.
